summary: Review what an agent changed: file by file, with the diff, comments, and accept or reject.
intent: Block: review an agent's change set. ChangeSummary on top; the changed files (ListView with +/− counts and a reviewed state) beside the selected file's InlineDiff, a Reviewed checkbox, Accept / Reject file and the file's comments (CommentThread, on the file or one changed line). Accept all is the one solid primary.
useWhen: an agent finished a change and a person reviews it before it lands
accept some files and reject others
leave comments on a file or a line for the agent or a teammate
doNotUseWhen: one proposed edit in a chat — InlineDiff
approve a plan before anything changes — PlanReview
one command or edit that needs an OK — ApprovalCard
what happened during the run — RunDetail

files.note: { id, path, kind?: "added" | "modified" | "deleted", lines (InlineDiff lines), hunkHeader?, additions?, deletions?, reviewed?, verdict?: "pending" | "accepted" | "rejected" }[]. Counts default to the lines.

summary.note: ChangeSummary items: { id, label, before, after, delta, direction, sentiment? }[].

comments.note: { id, fileId, line?, author, createdAt, body, edited?, parentId? }[]. A line comment reads "Line 18 · …" in the thread.

currentUserId.note: Your comments get Edit and Delete.

defaultSelectedFileId.note: Uncontrolled starting file; default the first.

onSelectFile.note: (fileId) => void. From the list, the previous / next buttons or J / K.

onReviewedChange.note: (fileId, reviewed) => void. The Reviewed checkbox or R.

onAccept.note: (fileId) => void. Accept file (outline, pressed when accepted).

onReject.note: (fileId) => void. Reject file (outline danger, pressed when rejected).

onAcceptAll.note: () => void. Accept all N files: every file without a verdict. The one solid primary; disabled when none are left.

onComment.note: (fileId, body, { line?, parentId? }) => void. Without it the comments area is hidden.

agent.note: Who made the change. Lead line.

layout: header with Accept all, ChangeSummary full width, then the file list beside the selected file in layout-split--secondary
the block is its own inline-size container; below --grid-breakpoint-md (64rem) of block width the list sits over the file

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title and aria-describedby the keys line; place it inside the page's <main>
the files are a kit ListView listbox named "Changed files, N · M reviewed"; each row's name carries the folder, +/− counts and its state (Not reviewed, Reviewed, Accepted, Rejected)
the selected file is a section labelled by its h3 file name, with "File i of N"
J / K select the next / previous file and R toggles Reviewed while focus is in the block and not in a text field; the buttons and checkbox carry aria-keyshortcuts
Accept file / Reject file are toggle buttons (aria-pressed)
Previous / Next file are icon buttons named with the file they go to
the diff is InlineDiff (+ / − marks, Added / Removed for screen readers); comments are CommentThread with a labelled Comment on Select

doNot: Do not rebuild ChangeReview from a local file list and diff; import the block
Only one solid primary: Accept all. InlineDiff gets no onAccept and the thread's Comment is soft
Do not show a file's change by colour alone; keep InlineDiff's + / − marks and the counts in words
snippet: <ChangeReview agent="Backend agent" files={files} summary={summary} comments={comments} currentUserId={me.id} onReviewedChange={markReviewed} onAccept={accept} onReject={reject} onAcceptAll={acceptAll} onComment={comment} />
